{{< video videos/alpha_helix_hbonds.mp4 >}}

A sixteen-residue alpha helix built from ideal backbone geometry into an MDAnalysis
     universe, with explicit amide hydrogens. The twelve O(i) to N(i+4) pairs are drawn with
     distance annotations, then the camera moves in on one turn to show the H···O pair.

     ProteinMotion detects the pairs with a geometric hydrogen-bond finder; the rulers here are
     placed by residue number.

After ProteinMotion's [`alpha_helix_hbonds.py`](https://github.com/pdpppd/proteinmotion/blob/main/examples/alpha_helix_hbonds.py).

## Script

Run it with `uv run python docs/examples/timeline/scripts/alpha_helix_hbonds.py out_dir`; set
`MN_EXAMPLES_QUICK=1` for a small, fast check. The script is included from the file:

```{.python filename="scripts/alpha_helix_hbonds.py"}
{{< include scripts/alpha_helix_hbonds.py >}}
```
